comment: Resource budgets, see docs/adr/0011-lean-by-default.md. Raise a budget only in a PR that explains why. Baselines measured 2026-11-11 on commit d99655e. Initial JS lowered to 90 KB with lazy widgets, pages and catalogues (#116; measured 33.3 KB on 2026-11-12). Binary raised to 18.9 MB for the briefing, countdown and focus modules (#52, #54, #58; measured 18.0 MB on 2026-11-12). Image raised to 8.8 MB to match the binary budget (image is about 0.46 x the binary; measured 8.56 MB on 2026-11-13 after #183, #198). Binary raised to 19.5 MB and image to 9.0 MB for the immich, fuel, releases, game deals and habits modules (#184, #186, #187, #188, #190; measured 19.0 MB and 8.71 MB on 2026-11-13, roughly 0.2 MB per module). piImageMB measured 2026-11-12 in the Raspberry Pi image workflow.
